datasets.notes: Pinned June 2026 coordinated community release; publisher SHA-256 verified. Parsed 5,589 questions, 2,509 accepted answers, and 3,779 other positively scored answers into 11,877 post documents and 13,531 chunks with exact per-post citations. The 19-case lexical gate achieved Success@1/5/10, MRR@10, and Recall@5/10/50 of 1.0. A verified 1,024-dimensional semantic generation improves the 14-case paraphrase gate over 256 dimensions, but hybrid Success@10 remains 0.571429, so BM25 is the strong baseline and semantic retrieval remains experimental for this corpus.

datasets.notes: Pinned June 2026 coordinated community release; publisher SHA-256 verified. The 271,298,857-byte archive expanded to 1,313,984,676 bytes. Parsed 70,265 questions, 32,426 accepted answers, and 68,350 other positively scored answers into 171,041 post documents and 188,770 chunks. The 18-topic lexical and final routed exact-query gates achieved Success@1/5/10, MRR@10, Recall@5/10/50, and nDCG@10 of 1.0. A verified 256-dimensional Qwen3-Embedding generation covers every chunk in 287,344,685 bytes of vector and metadata files. On 14 pooled paraphrase judgments, strict-AND BM25 found no relevant evidence while hybrid retrieval achieved Success@1 0.357143, Success@5 0.857143, Success@10 0.928571, Recall@50 0.704762, and MRR@10 0.53869. Reranking preserved Success@10 but slightly lowered Success@5, so automatic routing keeps terse technical phrases on strict BM25 while broader questions use hybrid retrieval.
